Inbound call triage. FAQ handling — account balance, status checks, policy queries. Complex cases routed to human agents with full context transferred. Post-call summaries generated automatically.

Collections & Recovery

TCPA/FDCPA-aware outbound agents that negotiate, set up payment plans, and recover revenue

Collections agents are expensive, hard to scale, and risk non-compliance. Regulatory exposure from FDCPA and TCPA violations can cost millions. Delinquency rates climb when call coverage falls.

Outbound reminder and negotiation calls. Payment plan enrollment over voice. FDCPA-compliant conversation flows. TCPA-aware dial rules. Dispute escalation to human agents. Full call recording and audit trail.

Appointment Booking

Fully automated scheduling — inbound booking, confirmations, and reminders

Scheduling calls tie up front-desk staff for 30–40% of their shift. No-shows cost $150–$250 per missed appointment. After-hours calls go to voicemail and are never booked.

What Gnani.ai Automates

24/7 inbound booking. Calendar sync and conflict resolution. Confirmation and reminder calls. Rescheduling and cancellation handling. Insurance pre-auth prompts (healthcare). Integration with EHR, dental PMS, and service platforms.

Onboarding & KYC

From first contact to verified account, voice and messaging workflows that keep customers moving without agent handholding

KYC drop-off lives in the gap between application and activation — generic SMS follow-ups lose customers, scripted verification calls fail to convert, and biometric re-verification gets skipped entirely. The result: a leaky funnel that CX and compliance teams blame each other for.

What Gnani.ai Automates

Voice biometric enrollment and liveness check. Consent capture and regulatory disclosures via voice. Activation welcome calls. WhatsApp, SMS, and voice follow-ups for pending docs. Dynamic sequencing by status. 22+ Indian languages. API integration with core banking and insurance CRM.

Reduction in KYC funnel drop-off

Survey Automation

High-response voice surveys at scale, for NPS, CSAT, Voice of Customer, and large-format research programs

SMS and email surveys are below 4% response rates. Human-run telephone research is too costly to scale. Research orgs need tens of thousands of responses in days; CX teams can't staff the volume. Decisions end up made on thin, biased data.

What Gnani.ai Automates

Outbound voice surveys for NPS, CSAT, and VoC. Conversational branching on live responses. Large-scale political polling and social research. Post-transaction feedback via CRM triggers. Real-time sentiment tagging. WhatsApp/SMS fallback. API integration with research platforms and CRMs.

Faster survey completion

Everything you need to know about Gnani's Voice AI platform, models, and deployment.

Which customer interactions can be automated with Gnani AI?

Gnani AI supports a wide range of customer interactions, including customer support, collections and recovery, appointment scheduling, lead qualification, onboarding, identity verification, and employee help desk workflows.

Can Gnani AI handle conversations across multiple channels?

Yes. The solutions are completely multi-modal. Gnani AI supports customer interactions across voice calls, WhatsApp, chat, SMS, and email, helping enterprises deliver consistent experiences across channels.

Which customer interactions can be automated with Gnani AI?

Gnani AI supports a wide range of customer interactions, including customer support, collections and recovery, appointment scheduling, lead qualification, onboarding, identity verification, and employee help desk workflows.

How quickly can enterprises start seeing value from Voice AI?

Organizations typically begin with a specific workflow or use case and expand from there. High-volume processes such as support, collections, scheduling, and outbound engagement often deliver measurable operational and customer experience improvements early on. Typical deployment timeframes vary between 2-4 weeks depending on the workflows.

Does Gnani AI replace human agents?

No. Gnani AI helps enterprises automate and augment repetitive interactions while empowering human agents with real-time assistance, guidance, and insights for more complex conversations.

Which industries use Gnani AI solutions?

Gnani AI supports enterprise use cases across BFSI, healthcare, telecom, hospitality, consumer durables, retail and FMCG
